# Coding standards

How code in this repo should be written. ADRs decide *what*; these standards decide *where and how* those decisions show up in code. The Standards axis of code review uses this file.

## Domain is the sole enforcer of protocol and business rules

**Rule:** Protocol and business invariants are asserted only in `internal/domain`. 

## No id's auto-generated by database

**Rule:** Application generates id's so tests can know entity identity without database round-trip.
